headline.en: Backend systems, security engineering, quantitative research and recommender systems.
headline.zh: 后端系统、安全工程、量化研究与推荐系统。

intro.en: Commerce student at the University of Melbourne. Each project below ships its tests and decision log in its repository.
intro.zh: 墨尔本大学商科在读。下面每个项目的测试和决策记录都在各自仓库里。

body.en: Go limit order book with a write-ahead command log and open-loop load testing: 5.05M–6.95M commands/s in the core, p99 1.76 ms at 10k requests/s.
body.zh: 用 Go 写的限价订单簿，带预写命令日志和开环压测：撮合核心每秒 505 万–695 万条命令，每秒 1 万个请求时 p99 为 1.76 ms。

body.en: End-to-end encryption on Web Crypto with an OWASP Top 10:2025 self-assessment; a sandboxed Electron app on a SQLCipher 4 format database.
body.zh: 基于 Web Crypto 的端到端加密，按 OWASP Top 10:2025 做了自评；渲染进程沙箱化的 Electron 应用，数据库采用 SQLCipher 4 格式加密。

body.en: Walk-forward analysis, purged cross-validation, PBO and the deflated Sharpe ratio, thresholds fixed before real data.
body.zh: 滚动前推分析、清洗交叉验证、回测过拟合概率（PBO）和紧缩夏普比率，阈值在接触真实数据之前固定。

body.en: Two-tower recall, gradient-boosted ranking, uplift models and off-policy evaluation, labelled by evidence tier.
body.zh: 双塔召回、梯度提升排序、增益模型和离策略评估，结果按证据等级标注。
